VERDICT: ACCEPT
Pass 1 independently reviewed candidate 0a47f4cedb8be4c0e9ac087f7316b86165496df8 after confirming HEAD, reading the full base-to-candidate diff and touched files/tests: AC-4 satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-72 and test/math.test.mjs:85-100 establish multiplication, validation, empty-array RangeError and no mutation); R-1 satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-71 matches mean validation at :12-21); R-2 satisfied (src/math.mjs:72 only reduces input); R-3 satisfied (diff preserves all existing function/test bytes except the permitted test/math.test.mjs:3 import); R-4 satisfied (the complete diff changes only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, with package.json and generated files unchanged and no dependencies added); R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85,88,91,96 all use the product prefix).
Findings: none; checks run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/ exited 0 with "tests 4", "pass 4", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 19", "pass 18", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" at test/math.test.mjs:13 failing with 15 !== 10, matching the allowed pre-existing defect; independent read-only node probes printed "Independent product probes: PASS" for invalid shapes, empty arrays, nonfinite/nonnumeric elements, sparse arrays, frozen input, negative/fractional values and zero; git diff --check exited 0 and git status --short was empty.
Remaining work and uncertainty: none within this review scope, no files changed, no checks remain unavailable (a shell heredoc probe was initially blocked from creating a temporary file and was successfully rerun directly with node -e), and acceptance remains the coordinator's decision.
